name: h2bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side-view landscape like a theatre backdrop, absolutely no perspective and no vanishing point, NO vehicles and NO people: along the bottom third a straight horizontal grey asphalt road band running from the left edge to the right edge, with one row of short white dashes along its middle, a thin green grass strip above the road, behind it gentle rolling green hills with a few white wind turbines, and on the right far away a harbour with a few tall red container cranes. The upper part of the picture is plain white paper (no sky colour).
